bosons.name: gluon
bosons.source: the eight traceless combinations of the port responses on the three vector levels
bosons.travelling_excitation: open (worker X5): needs a link variable in the colour group
bosons.mass: zero by gauge invariance, if it travels

bosons.name: W+
bosons.source: the response that moves a quantum from s2 to s1 (weak raising)
bosons.acts_on: left-handed patterns only (exactly one spinor level occupied); annihilates right-handed ones
bosons.mass: from the state that fixes the neutral doublet level (open, R8)

bosons.name: W-
bosons.source: the response that moves a quantum from s1 to s2 (weak lowering)

bosons.name: Z
bosons.source: the neutral combination of T3 and Y orthogonal to the electric charge
bosons.acts_on: every pattern with T3 or Y
bosons.mass: from the same state; mixing angle open (representation level: sum T3^2 / sum Q^2 = 3/8)

bosons.name: photon
bosons.source: the electric charge Q = T3 + Y, the combination the neutral toggle leaves unbroken
bosons.acts_on: every charged pattern, equally on both handedness classes
bosons.travelling_excitation: open (X5): needs a U(1) link phase; with one, the lowest Landau level sits at the rest phase (g = 2)

bosons.name: Higgs
bosons.source: the two spinor levels as a multiplet (charges of a doublet with 6Y = 3); its neutral member s2 is the toggle that joins left and right
bosons.acts_on: every fermion type through the toggle
bosons.travelling_excitation: open (R8, X5): the excitation of the register that takes the toggled charge

generations.required: three copies of every fermion type with identical charges and different masses
generations.public_theorem: Lean/Screen/A5FamilyBand.lean and the gauge-structure paper, Proposition "conditional screen-band selection": the twelve-port load space has bands of ranks 1, 3, 3, 5 with costs 5 - sqrt5 < 6 < 5 + sqrt5; if one faithful band carries the families and lower cost selects, it is the rank-three band of cost 5 - sqrt5; tensored with the fifteen states of a generation it is a conditional rank-45 candidate

candidates.label: the rank-three load band resolved along the three axes of the gauge-fixed cubic frame
candidates.status: best guess; uses the public theorem; the three axes carry three different characters of the frame half-turns; masses equal unless the symmetry between the axes is broken

candidates.label: the three further cones of the routing tick, labelled by the frame axes ((0,pi/2,pi/2), (pi/2,0,pi/2), (pi/2,pi/2,0) in two-tick wave number)
candidates.status: exact objects of the tick (workers R3, R4); two of them are mirror copies; the tick treats axis 2 differently from axes 1 and 3

candidates.label: the three characters of the Z3 holonomy of the port-to-port frame rule on the spherical federation
candidates.status: two of the three are complex conjugates and degenerate
